rationale: Price is currently trapped in conflicting cross-currents: a short-term 1-minute bounce reclaiming the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.00) and the psychological $10.00 level, against overhead resistance at the session VWAP ($10.16) while sitting in the lower third of the daily range.
